description: Returns the text of one or more passages, side by side in the requested editions, with a link to the chapter on bible.flogvit.com. Use include_notes for the translators' footnotes (translation choices, Greek/Hebrew linguistics, textual criticism, history, theology) and alternative renderings.

editions.description: Editions to show side by side, 1-5 of: osnb (Norwegian Bokmål), osnn (Norwegian Nynorsk), osen (English), oses (Spanish), sblgnt (Greek New Testament), tanach (Hebrew Old Testament), kjv (King James Version, English), web (World English Bible), bsb (Berean Standard Bible, English), asv (American Standard Version, English), luther_1912 (Luther 1912, German), segond_1910 (Louis Segond 1910, French), rv_1909 (Reina-Valera 1909, Spanish), akjv (American King James Version, English), albanian (Albanian Bible), bungo (Bungo-yaku, classical Japanese), cadman (Cadman 1926, Vietnamese), chinese_union_simp (Chinese Union Version, simplified), chinese_union_trad (Chinese Union Version, traditional), cpdv (Catholic Public Domain Version, English), dbt (Darby Translation, English), diodati (Diodati, Italian), drb (Douay-Rheims (Challoner), English), elberfelder_1905 (Elberfelder 1905, German), elberfelder_1871 (Elberfelder 1871, German), dnb30 (Bibelselskapet 1930, Norwegian Bokmål), erv (English Revised Version), finn (Finnish 1776), geneva (Geneva Bible, English), hcv (Haitian Creole Bible (1985)), he_modern (Modern Hebrew Bible (Delitzsch NT)), jps (JPS Tanakh 1917, English), kougo (Kougo-yaku 1954/55, Japanese), lv_gluck_8 (Glück Bible, Latvian), martin (Martin 1744, French), opt (Old Persian Version, Persian), rv_1858 (Reina-Valera 1858 New Testament, Spanish), sagradas (Sagradas Escrituras 1569, Spanish), slt (Smith's Literal Translation, English), swahili (Swahili New Testament), synodal (Synodal Translation 1876, Russian), tagab (Ang Biblia 1905, Tagalog), wbt (Webster Bible 1833, English). Default: the edition for `language`.

include_notes.description: true adds the translators' footnotes and alternative renderings under each verse. Default: false.

language.description: Language for names, notes and study content, and for the links to bible.flogvit.com: en (English), nb (Norwegian Bokmål), nn (Norwegian Nynorsk), sv (Swedish), fr (French), es (Spanish), fi (Finnish), de (German). Content missing in a language falls back to English. Default: en.

mapping.description: Verse numbering to read the reference in and to number the answer in: a mapping id from list_verse_mappings, e.g. "english_kj" (King James), "dnb2024_nb" (Bibelselskapet 2024), or a short name such as "kjv" or "dnb2024". Numberings differ where a psalm heading is a verse or not, and at chapter breaks: Malachi 4:5 in the King James numbering is Malachi 3:23 in osnb. Default: osnb, the site's own numbering, which follows the Hebrew and Greek.

reference.description: Bible reference in English or Norwegian style, e.g. "John 3:16", "Joh 3,16-18", "1 Cor 13:4-7", "Ps 23", "Gen 1:1-2:3". Several separated by ";": "Rom 8:28; 9:1; John 3:16".

name: get_passage
title: Read a Bible passage
